name: Church of Our Lady of Perpetual Succour

rules.note: Liturgy of the Word for Children on 2nd & 4th Sundays

notes: Weekday Mass on a public holiday is at 8.00am only.
Adoration room is closed every Wednesday from 10.00am to 12 noon for cleaning.

info.adoration: Adoration room open 6.00am to 10:15pm daily, closed every Wednesday from 10.00am to 12 noon for cleaning.
info.confession: 30 minutes before every weekend Mass in the Main Church.
devotions: Divine Mercy Devotion: Tuesdays 6.45pm in the Main Church
Rosary Prayers: Mondays to Fridays 5.15pm in the Main Church
Christian Meditation: Wednesdays 8pm in St John/St Luke room
info.office_hours: Parish Office: Mon & Sat 9am-6pm; Tue-Fri 9am-8pm; Sun 9am-1pm; closed on public holidays.
good_to_know: Parking at St Stephen's School: Sat 3.00pm-7.00pm, Sun 8.00am-2.00pm; no overnight parking.
Standing along the aisles during Mass and services is not permitted.

events.title: Level 1 Catechism Registration for 2027 (Phase 1)
events.text: Children born in 2020 may register for Level 1 catechism in 2027. Phase 1 (10-16 Oct) is for siblings of students enrolled in catechism Levels 1-10 at OLPS in 2026. Register online via olps.sg/cats; registration closes 6 Nov 2026.

events.title: Intercessory Prayer Session for L9 Confirmation Retreat
events.text: Join the OLPS Intercessory Prayer Group and OLPS Children's Eucharistic Adoration to pray for all involved in the L9 Confirmation Retreat, 8.00pm-9.00pm at the OLPS Adoration Room.

events.title: Book of Remembrance
events.text: The parish Book of Remembrance will be placed in the Main Church from 17 Oct to 2 Nov 2026; parishioners are invited to inscribe the names of departed family members and friends.

events.title: Young Missionaries of Hope: One in Christ, United in Mission
events.text: Virtual Zoom event on Sat 17 Oct, 3.00pm-5.30pm, reflecting on being young missionary disciples. Sign up at bit.ly/unitedinmission.

events.title: Intercessory Prayer Session for L9 Confirmation Retreat
events.text: Join the OLPS Intercessory Prayer Group and OLPS Children's Eucharistic Adoration to pray for all involved in the L9 Confirmation Retreat, 8.00pm-9.00pm at the OLPS Adoration Room.

events.title: Milestone Wedding Celebration @ OLPS
events.text: Couples celebrating milestone wedding anniversaries (5th, 10th, 15th and multiples of 5 years thereafter) are invited to the 6:30pm Mass followed by a dinner celebration. Enquiries: Patrick @ 91797723; register at olps.sg/milestone2026 by 30 Oct 2026.

events.title: OLPS Family Weekend 2026
events.text: Open to families with children aged 7 to 21, 21 & 22 Nov 2026 at St Stephen's School. Registration fee $50 per family; register by 23 Oct 2026. Enquiries: James @ 9880 2203 or familylife@olps.sg.

events.title: L9 Confirmation Retreat - TREASURED (Service Team)
events.text: The L9 Confirmation Retreat runs 27-29 Nov 2026 at Catholic Spirituality Centre (stay-in). Youth are invited to serve on the Service Team; scan the QR code or contact the Catechetical or Youth Office.
